rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Thanks to my 'helpless, weak sex slave' act, the Gobin lookouts were starting to
rows.current: text: 多亏我装成‘无助软弱的性奴’，哥布林哨兵开始有点放松警惕了。所以，等时机一到……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: get a little bit complacent. So, when the time was right...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I jimmied open that cage and scrambled down out of the trees!
rows.current: text: 我撬开笼子，连滚带爬地下了树！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Damn though, that Gobinventure really took a lot out of me, and I wasn't
rows.current: text: 该死，那场哥布林历险真把我榨干了，我可一点也不乐意把任务从头再来一遍……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: relishing having to start my mission over from square one...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...but as fate would have it, I didn't have to.
rows.current: text: ……不过命运眷顾，我倒不用费那个心了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: 'Are you lost, little one?' The tall Elf lady asked me.
rows.current: text: “迷路了吗，小家伙？”高挑的精灵女士问我。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I quickly retorted that I wasn't some little pup, but she wasn't listening!
rows.current: text: 我立刻反驳说我才不是什么小狗崽，可她根本不听！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: As weak as I was, I didn't have much choice but to go with her. Hmf!
rows.current: text: 我太虚弱，除了跟她走也没别的办法。哼！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was captive again! Though... the elves... made it a lot more relaxing...
rows.current: text: 我又被俘了！不过……那些精灵……让人放松多了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: After all that rough sex and sleeping on the hard floor of my cage for weeks
rows.current: text: 被粗暴地干了几周，又一直睡笼子的硬地板后，能洗个澡真是舒服……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: it was pretty nice to get a bath...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...even if those Elf ladies made my boobs feel a bit small...
rows.current: text: ……虽然跟那几位精灵女士一比，我的奶子显得有点小……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But during my bath, I started to feel a little bit *too* relaxed.
rows.current: text: 可泡着泡着，我开始觉得有点*太*放松了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Like I'd been drugged, or... or something...?
rows.current: text: 像被下了药，或……或是什么……？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I tried to scamper away when I noticed, but my head swam and my legs were jelly.
rows.current: text: 发觉不对后我想赶紧溜，可脑袋发晕，双腿软得像泥。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: One of the Elf ladies pinned me to a rock in their bathing spring... and...
rows.current: text: 一位精灵女士把我按在浴泉的岩石上……然后……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...oh god... just went down on me... and I just *melted* for her...
rows.current: text: ……天啊……直接舔起我的下面……我都为她*化了*……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I had a hard time staying focused for a while, after that...
rows.current: text: 那之后，好一阵子我都很难集中精神……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The Elf ladies kept cooing at me. 'Shh. Just relax, puppy... good girl.'
rows.current: text: 精灵女士们不停柔声哄我：“嘘，放松，小狗……乖女孩。”

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Without the strength to resist their training, I simply did as I was told...
rows.current: text: 无力反抗她们的调教，我只能乖乖听话……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...and the more I obeyed, the better it felt...
rows.current: text: ……而我越听话，就越舒服……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now that I've collected my thoughts, everything has become totally clear.
rows.current: text: 如今理清思绪，一切都彻底明白了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It was foolish for me, a dumb little puppy, to think I could save the planet...
rows.current: text: 我这只笨小狗，竟以为能拯救星球，真傻……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: My place is to follow along quietly and to serve my mistresses.
rows.current: text: 我只该乖乖跟着，服侍我的女主人们。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: If you're watching this, know that the galaxy is in safe hands now.
rows.current: text: 若你正看着这段记录，请放心，银河如今有人守护了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Trust in the proud Elf rangers of Sceafya and their wise leader...
rows.current: text: 请相信斯凯菲亚骄傲的精灵游侠，以及睿智的领袖……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Her peerless grace, my queen! High Lady Enelye!
rows.current: text: 风华无双的陛下，我的女王！恩莉耶大人！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [Agent Yiffany did not return from her mission on Planet Tutone.]
rows.current: text: [伊吠妮特工未从图托恩星的任务中归来。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [She was last active on EXILE, a small asteroid orbiting the planet.]
rows.current: text: [她最后在流放地活动，那是绕该星球运行的小行星。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [Based on her final recordings, it is unlikely that the agent survived...]
rows.current: text: [根据最后的录音判断，该特工生还的可能性极低……]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [...but, as no remains have been recovered, her precise fate remains unclear.]
rows.current: text: [……但尚未寻获遗骸，她的确切命运仍不明。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [All agent communications from Tutone have since ceased.]
rows.current: text: [自此，来自图托恩的全部特工通讯均已中断。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [Our mission logs indicate that some dark 'queen' might be in search of]
rows.current: text: [任务日志显示，某位黑暗“女王”可能正在寻找]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [a new host body, and may be seeking to expand her influence beyond Tutone...]
rows.current: text: [新的宿主躯体，并可能企图把势力扩张到图托恩之外……]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [STARDATE XXXX:XXXX:XXXX.XX] [PLANET TUTONE, 5555 SYSTEM] [MAGNETOSHEATHE ENTRY POINT]
rows.current: text: [星历 XXXX:XXXX:XXXX.XX] [5555星系，图托恩星] [磁鞘进入点]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...entry successful, en route to descend at 40N, 74W in T-minus XXXX unisecs.
rows.current: text: ……成功进入，正前往北纬40、西经74，距下降还剩XXXX标准秒。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Engine temp stable at 2640 degrees, plasma, oxygen and battery levels good.
rows.current: text: 引擎温度稳定在2640度，等离子、氧气和电量均正常。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: This is Cosmobreeder Yiffany, can I get a mission update, Bossu?
rows.current: text: 这里是宇宙育种者伊吠妮。波苏，能更新下任务情报吗？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: That's commanding officer Bossu, Yiffany. Don't forget that!
rows.current: text: 要叫波苏指挥官，伊吠妮。别忘了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: We here at HQ are all thankful that you took this mission on short notice.
rows.current: text: 总部上下都很感谢你临时接下这次任务。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Oh yeah, no problem! If my little bro is all tangled up in it like you say he is
rows.current: text: 当然，没问题！要是我弟真像你说的那样卷进去了，那救他的机会，我说什么也不会错过！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: then I wouldn't miss being the one to rescue him for the world!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It's sad that your brother Yiffai was introduced to Cosmobreeding this way
rows.current: text: 你弟弟伊吠竟以这种方式接触宇宙育种，令人遗憾，可同一趟任务里，还有比他更有经验的特工。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but there were more experienced agents on the same mission as he was.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: You know the drill. Your mission is to gather as much useful bio data as you can
rows.current: text: 规矩你懂。任务是尽量收集有用的生物数据，同时设法找到失踪的特工同伴，无论他们身在何处。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: while also attempting to find your missing fellow agents, wherever they are.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Just make...sur...ou...on your...oes...or....
rows.current: text: 只要确……保……你……多加……小……心……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Mewahaha! What's this? Another little spacebug entering my domain?
rows.current: text: 喵哈哈！怎么，又有小太空虫闯进我的领地了？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Enjoy your crash landing like your other little interlopers did, puppy!
rows.current: text: 小狗，跟先前那些小入侵者一样，好好享受坠机吧！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: What? Just who the heck are you?
rows.current: text: 什么？你到底是谁？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: And where the heck did all these ships come from?
rows.current: text: 还有，这些飞船到底打哪儿来的？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Alright this is a little ruffer than I was expecting!
rows.current: text: 好吧，这可比我预想的颠得厉害！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: If you can hear me Bossu my engine's been hit! Making emergency descent!
rows.current: text: 波苏，听见了吗？引擎中弹！正在紧急下降！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.current: text: ……好疼。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Well, I guess that's what I get for not taking things serious up there.
rows.current: text: 唉，这大概就是我在上头掉以轻心的报应。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Gotta remember that there were some experienced agents that went missing
rows.current: text: 得记住，失踪的还有好些经验丰富的特工，可不止我家小弟！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: not just my baby bro!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: This ol' ship should be good to go for low orbit maneuvers at least.
rows.current: text: 这老飞船至少还能在低轨道上机动。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I oughtta get more than just my flight jacket on, and maybe take a look around...
rows.current: text: 我该多穿点，不能光披飞行夹克，再四处看看……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Hey, wait a minute!!
rows.current: text: 喂，等等啊！！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: What the heck do you think you're doing you little thief?!?
rows.current: text: 你这小贼，搞什么鬼呢？！？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Seriously? Escaping down some dingy dark little hole?
rows.current: text: 不是吧？竟然钻进又脏又黑的小洞逃跑？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Maaaan, this is NOT how I like my missions to start out!
rows.current: text: 天哪，我可不想任务一开始就这么倒霉！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Some big breasted punk and her floozies shooting me down...
rows.current: text: 先是大奶混混和她那帮骚货把我击落……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...and then some little brat stealing my gear!
rows.current: text: ……接着又有个小混蛋偷走了我的装备！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Whatever, this is as good a place to start exploring as any.
rows.current: text: 管它呢，从这儿开始探索也没什么不好。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Who knows, maybe there'll be some interesting creatures to find down here too!
rows.current: text: 谁知道呢，说不定下面也有些有趣的生物可找！

rows.source: Nooo! Curse you damn Yiffai siblings!
rows.current: text: 不要啊！诅咒你们，该死的伊吠姐弟！

rows.source: I was supposed to rule the world... no... the Galaxy!
rows.current: text: 我本该统治世界的……不……是整个银河！

rows.source: And now... now...!
rows.current: text: 而现在……现在……！

rows.source: GAAAAARRRRRRRGGGGGGGHGHHHH!
rows.current: text: 嘎啊啊啊——呜噢噢噢——呃呃呃！

rows.source: Wow sis, did we really just... save a whole planet?
rows.current: text: 哇，姐姐，我们刚才真的……救了整整一颗星球？

rows.source: Yeah lil bro, I think we did! Par for the course on my missions, really.
rows.current: text: 是啊，小弟，我想是的！在我执行的任务里这都算家常便饭了。

rows.source: Buuut pretty impressive for my baby bro's first real mission, so good going!
rows.current: text: 不——过嘛，对我家小弟的第一次真正任务来说已经相当厉害了，干得漂亮！

rows.source: The heroes of Tutone! They return!
rows.current: text: 图托恩的英雄们！他们回来了！

rows.source: Traeh has been defeated, her psychic disturbances are no more and her minions flee!
rows.current: text: Traeh已被击败，她的灵能扰动不复存在，她的手下四散逃窜！

rows.source: Cheers for the heroes!
rows.current: text: 为英雄们欢呼！

rows.source: YIP! YIP! HOORAY!
rows.current: text: 汪！汪！万岁！

rows.source: YIP! YIP! HOORAY!
rows.current: text: 汪！汪！万岁！

rows.source: BLESSED BE THE COSMOBREEDERS, SAVIORS OF OUR PLANET!
rows.current: text: 赞颂宇宙育种者，我们星球的救星！

rows.source: Wow, good going you two! Clearing out a whole planet of baddies...
rows.current: text: 哇，你们俩真棒！把整颗星球的坏蛋都清理干净了……

rows.source: That's definitely gonna help the local fauna get back on track!
rows.current: text: 这肯定能帮当地的动物们重回正轨！

rows.source: I knew you two could do it. Never had a doubt in my mind.
rows.current: text: 我就知道你们俩能做到。我心里从没怀疑过。

rows.source: Not even when one of you went AWOL and stopped responding to all communica-
rows.current: text: 就连你们中有人擅离职守、不再回应任何通——

rows.source: -Ahem...
rows.current: text: -嗯哼……

rows.source: This will definitely be a good report to have filed away, Agents!
rows.current: text: 这份报告绝对值得归档留存，特工们！

rows.source: Nice one, grrrrl! You and your pup brother really cleaned up down there!
rows.current: text: 干得漂亮，姑娘！你和你那小狗崽弟弟在下面可真把坏蛋收拾干净了！

rows.source: Just don't forget about us at HQ when all the fame goes to your heads, alright?
rows.current: text: 只是等名气让你们忘乎所以的时候，可别忘了还在总部的我们，好吗？

rows.source: HOORAH FOR YIFFANY AND YIFFAI! STAR COSMOBREEDERS!
rows.current: text: 为伊吠妮和伊吠欢呼！明星级宇宙育种者！

rows.source: H O O R A Y ! ! !
rows.current: text: 好 耶 ！ ！ ！

rows.source: Heh, how about that, sis? We made a pretty good team, didn't we?
rows.current: text: 嘿，瞧见没，姐姐？我们配合得挺不错，不是吗？

rows.source: Wellll... you did alright, bro.
rows.current: text: 嗯——……你还行啦，老弟。

rows.source: ...for a pup.
rows.current: text: ……就一只小崽子而言。

rows.source: [SO ENDS THE REPORT ON PLANET TUTONE.]
rows.current: text: [图托恩星球的报告至此结束。]

rows.source: [A PLANET WITH A TUMULTUOUS HISTORY, FACING THE GREATEST CHALLENGES OF ITS TIME]
rows.current: text: [一颗历史动荡、正面临其时代最严峻挑战的星球]

rows.source: [SAVED BY THE VALIANT EFFORTS OF TWO BRAVE COSMOBREEDERS:]
rows.current: text: [因两位勇敢的宇宙育种者的英勇努力而获救：]

rows.source: [YIFFANY YIFFAI, ELDER SISTER AND SEASONED VETERAN WITH UNMATCHED COMBAT SKILL]
rows.current: text: [伊吠妮·伊吠，姐姐，久经沙场的老兵，拥有无与伦比的战斗技巧]

rows.source: [AND YIFFAI YIFFAI, THE YOUNGER BROTHER PRODIGY WITH UNENDING ENTHUSIASM]
rows.current: text: [以及伊吠·伊吠，热情永不枯竭的天才弟弟]

rows.source: [WITH THE TWO OF THEM TEAMED UP, THERE'S NO MISSION THAT THEY CAN'T HANDLE]
rows.current: text: [两人联手，没有他们应付不了的任务]

rows.source: [AND THE PPP IS PROUD TO HAVE THEM AS AGENTS.]                      -SIGNED, BOSSU
rows.current: text: [PPP以有这两位特工为荣。]                      ——署名：波苏

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: What? Trying to spirit away again?
rows.current: text: 什么？又想溜走？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Come on! There's no way you're getting away like that!
rows.current: text: 少来！你休想就这么逃走！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Hang on lil bro, I'm about to show you some real flying!
rows.current: text: 抓紧了，弟弟，马上让你见识什么才叫真正的驾驶技术！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Here we go! Full turbo! This ship is fully locked and fully loaded!
rows.current: text: 来了！涡轮全开！这艘飞船武器就绪，弹药满载！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now let's take down this wannabe queen for real!
rows.current: text: 现在就来彻底打倒这个妄称女王的家伙！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Here we go!!!
rows.current: text: 出发啦！！！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...ahhh, what a nice soft piece of rocky ground here.
rows.current: text: ……啊，这块石地真是又软又舒服。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Much more comfy than getting smacked around repeatedly!
rows.current: text: 比被一顿接一顿地揍舒服多了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: So comfy that I might just take a little...
rows.current: text: 舒服得让我想稍微……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...nappyroo...
rows.current: text: ……睡个觉觉……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Oh man, I must've slept for too long or something. My head's all fuzzy...
rows.current: text: 天哪，我是不是睡太久了，脑袋迷迷糊糊的……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I mean, it's usually fuzzy... but now it's fuzzy on the /inside/...
rows.current: text: 我是说，平时也毛茸茸的……但现在/里面/也毛乎乎的……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Just gotta make my way out of here nice and easy, one step at a ti-
rows.current: text: 只要慢慢离开这里就好，一步一——

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: -WAHHH!
rows.current: text: ——哇啊啊！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Ow! My manly chiselled posterior! What fiend could be responsible
rows.current: text: 嗷！我那阳刚雕塑般的翘臀！是哪个恶徒趁我虚弱时，狠狠把我撞翻在地？？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: for violently knocking me off my feet in my moment of weakness??

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...oh, it's just some sort of weird goop. Blech!
rows.current: text: ……哦，只是些奇怪的黏糊玩意。呸！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: This stuff is both slimy AND sticky somehow.
rows.current: text: 这玩意怎么又滑又黏的。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Ugh, it's almost like it's building up the more I struggle.
rows.current: text: 呃，简直像是我越挣扎，它就积得越多。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: B-back off slime! Let go of me already! D-don't wiggle into my lap!!
rows.current: text: 退、退开，史莱姆！快放开我！别、别往我腿上钻！！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Ahh! Ahh!
rows.current: text: 啊！啊！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Stop that! That's a n-naughty place for slime to beeeennngh...!
rows.current: text: 住手！史莱姆不、不该钻进那种羞人的地方啊嗯……！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I-if only I could use my hands to hold onto you, t-then I could show you
rows.current: text: 要、要是双手能抱住你，我、我就能让你见识宇宙育种者真正的本事！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: what a Cosmobreeder is REALLY capable of!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: My... my hands are free? I should... I should...
rows.current: text: 我……我的手自由了？我该……我该……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I should run... but this feels too good! Nnngh!
rows.current: text: 我该逃的……可这也太舒服了！嗯呃！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: My Cosmohips can't stop moving on their own, this jelly feels too good.
rows.current: text: 我的宇宙翘臀自己动个不停，这胶冻也太爽了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It's like a toy for me to thrust into. Nnngh! So.... so good! Ahh!
rows.current: text: 简直像个任我插的玩具。嗯呃！好……好爽！啊！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Huff... okay... now to take the chance to escaWAHH!
rows.current: text: 呼……好……现在趁机逃——哇啊！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Slimes don't even have dicks! Why are y-you trying to penetrate...
rows.current: text: 史莱姆连鸡巴都没有！你、你还想插进……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Ahh! Don't press there! You're... oh gosh... you're making me squirt...!
rows.current: text: 啊！别按那里！你……天哪……你弄得我要射了……！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: No no! I'm done humping! I don't need help to s-squirt more... Stop making me...
rows.current: text: 不不！我已经干完了！不用帮我再、再射了……别再弄得我……
